name: fourth-down-go
plainWords: Going for it on fourth down: with one down left to gain the first down, the offense ran or passed instead of punting or trying a field goal. A fake punt or a fake field goal counts as going, because the play was a rush or a pass.
comparedWith: every other fourth-down decision: a punt or a field goal attempt
cannotSee: whether going was the right call, what a punt or a kick would have been worth instead, who made the call, a try that a penalty wiped out, or a team that lined up to go and then took a delay penalty and punted
